goal: Release v11.1 as a five-minute external operator reproduction drill for AOF next-task judgment.
risk: AOF may claim users can understand its decision when the evidence path is still too vague, too long, or too internally framed.
loss_boundary: No v11.1 wording may claim third-party adoption, market truth, semantic truth, production provider execution, or broad usability proof.
evidence_plan: operator reproduction artifact, audit artifact, release docs, capability register, capability delta, product value evidence, Council review, release-state audit
stop_conditions: Stop if the drill requires reading the whole repository
Stop if the operator cannot reproduce the selected task reasoning
Stop if release-state-audit reports missing TASK-132 governance evidence
